# iru_tag (List Resource)

Lists existing `iru_tag` objects for `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "iru_tag" "all" {
  provider         = iru
  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list tags with exactly this name.
